scripts.typegen:check: node -e "const{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const{mkdtempSync,readFileSync,rmSync}=require('node:fs');const{join}=require('node:path');const{tmpdir}=require('node:os');const t=mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'typegen-check-'));try{const bin=join('node_modules','.bin',process.platform==='win32'?'openapi-typescript.cmd':'openapi-typescript');execFileSync(bin,['../openapi.json','-o',join(t,'api.d.ts')],{stdio:'inherit',shell:process.platform==='win32'});const fresh=readFileSync(join(t,'api.d.ts'),'utf8');const committed=readFileSync('src/api/generated/api.d.ts','utf8');if(fresh!==committed){console.error('typegen:check 失败：openapi.json 与 src/api/generated/api.d.ts 不一致，请运行 npm run typegen 重新生成并提交');process.exit(1)}console.log('typegen:check 通过：生成物与 openapi.json 一致')}finally{rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true})}"
